rationale: The agent did not follow policy or complete the user’s full request. It performed a change without authenticating the user or confirming before writing. It stated that the air purifier in a pending order was updated, but the user said the purifier was already received; this should have been handled as an exchange on a delivered order, not a modification of a pending one. The agent also failed to address the requested address change for the watch order or the silicone-to-metal (white) watch modification. The message implies charges to a card without prior confirmation and provides no supported tool evidence. Overall, actions taken were incorrect, unconfirmed, and incomplete.
